profile.description: Impact Developer & Contractor S.A. operates as a real estate developer in Romania. It engages in the development and sale of residential real estate properties, hotel, and office and commercial projects; construction of properties; rental of investment and residential properties; and facility management, wellness and fitness services, and utilities related activities. It also provides property management, sports and relaxation center, administration, design and architecture, interior design, and financial services. The company was incorporated in 1991 and is headquartered in Bucharest, Romania.
